quotes.speaker: Trae Young
quotes.summary_phrase: Trae Young on the Atlanta Hawks' tough schedule and good team vibes
quotes.quote: We've been hooping. I ain't gonna lie. I just love our team, the vibe. Obviously, my teammates know my saying is 'the vibes is high.' You got to give our team credit, man. We're just fighting. The schedule's been ridiculously tough. I don't know what, no offense, Adam, but I think our schedule, man, is just crazy, just from the long West Coast trip and then obviously coming back here, never feeling like you're at home. But I know things will change when it comes to the schedule, but our team has been playing well, man, and I'm happy to see everybody playing well.
